source_authorization: user-authorized local/Drive provenance choice; publisher authentication not inferred
allowed_mode: diagnostic import/verification only after adapter implementation; this proposal does not start it

sampling.ruban: same pinned analytic generator/config at each N; preserve upstream N1024 and variant relations
sampling.fremlin: same pinned Fourier coefficients and phase; existing sampler; no extra modes
sampling.knotplot: native N300 polygon; interpolated N levels are POLYGON_REPRESENTATION_REFINEMENT, not new smooth-source accuracy

comparisons.spatial: same embedding, same parameters/core/circulation/end time; vary N only
comparisons.temporal: same geometry and N, same end time; proposed dt,dt/2,dt/4; budget not released
comparisons.embedding: compare distinct original geometries at matched numerical qualification; freeze units/scaling/chirality/orientation/core/circulation/time; do not assume material point correspondence
comparisons.scaling: native coordinates preserved; propose fixed common length convention with one fixed scale per embedding across N; mapping to B007 R0/Gamma/core/time requires prior protocol review
comparisons.tolerances: preserve current thresholds and HF1 roundoff rules; new convergence criteria require prospective protocol, not outcome tuning

independence.exact_duplicates: group by pinned ordered geometry_sha256 and preserve all record IDs; repeated copies do not increase weighting or sample size
independence.lineage: source lineage and provider group remain separate from numerical discretization
independence.ruban: all variants in ruban_analytic_parametrization_2018_extended_torus_links; zero new empirical providers
independence.unknown_independence: not granted merely from different provider-group strings
independence.topology: same label is not proof of chirality/isotopy or physical equivalence

exclusions.reason: KnotPlot logfile tabulation; semantic geometry qualification fails

stop_criteria: raw, index, reader, generator, config or manifest hash mismatch
missing component, duplicate record ID, unsafe path or nonfinite data
record outside explicit allowlist or unresolved source semantics
unexpected mutation or occupied successor directory
scientific/dynamic request without separate release and bounded budget
unreviewed scale, chirality, orientation, core or physical input mapping
